cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Declare Allegiance
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which person, side, or claim to authority they will support.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved your help at the chess club election. Will you wear my ribbon or Nina's?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may remain friends with both of us. I'm asking which of us you want as chair.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I wear yours today and hers tomorrow?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tomorrow's the vote. I won't approve a timetable that postpones your answer until I'm not here. Tell me whose ribbon you'll wear to vote.

reason: Remove invented access to a rival ribbon; A treats friendship and rotation as permissions while demanding the consequential allegiance choice.
